page.running_head: Cap. 4. De præs. reali corp. Christi

main_text.l: diceret, qui non in me manet, &
in quo ego non maneo: non se dicat aut edere
carnem meam manducare corpus meum, aut
2. Quid sit explicat tract. 26. in Ioh.
Christo, & in quo non manet Christus, prorsus
ejus, nec bibit ejus sanguinem : licet
Christi: sed magis tantæ rei Sacramentum

page.notes: The running head is printed with the chapter title and the page number 78 at the top; the marginal notes are only partly legible and the right-hand page is cut. Several marginal words were not readable and are transcribed as best possible; the left-margin mark "o" is a reference symbol. The second printed page at the right edge is cut off and not transcribed. Words of the marginal notes and of the line ends at the right edge are doubtful. Right-margin notes and the far-right column are heavily cropped and faint; only fragments are legible (e.g. "cap", "qui", "lis", "de", "stri", "po", "De", "co", "27", "vi", "fan", "vid", "tio", "h. e", "ver", "spi") and are not transcribed. Some words in the main text are doubtful due to show-through and blur, notably "sibi judicium" and the marginal word fragments.
